---
title: "Minordilemma"
output: html_document
---
Goal: tabulate the results for all our major factors (main effects and the various interactions), with means and standard deviations.


```{r}
rm(list = ls())
setwd("~/")
library(ggplot2)
library(pixiedust)
library(plyr)

outputtotal <- read.csv("outputtotal.csv",header = TRUE, sep = ",")

summary(outputtotal)
tapply(outputtotal$BlameResponse, outputtotal$Condition, mean, na.rm = T)
outputtotal$Agent<-ifelse(outputtotal$Condition== "HNo-P", "Human", 
                     ifelse(outputtotal$Condition== "HNo", "Human",
                            ifelse(outputtotal$Condition== "HYes", "Human",
                                   ifelse(outputtotal$Condition== "HYes-P", "Human", "Robot"))))
outputtotal$Agent<-as.factor(outputtotal$Agent)

outputtotal$Response<-ifelse(outputtotal$Condition== "HNo-P", "No", 
                     ifelse(outputtotal$Condition== "HNo", "No",
                            ifelse(outputtotal$Condition== "RNo", "No",
                                   ifelse(outputtotal$Condition== "RNo-P", "No", "Yes"))))

outputtotal$DetailedResponse<-ifelse(outputtotal$Condition== "HNo-P", "NoPolite", 
                     ifelse(outputtotal$Condition== "RNo-P", "NoPolite",
                            ifelse(outputtotal$Condition== "RNo", "No",
                                   ifelse(outputtotal$Condition== "HNo", "No", 
                                          ifelse(outputtotal$Condition== "HYes", "Yes",
                                                 ifelse(outputtotal$Condition== "RYes","Yes",
                                                        ifelse(outputtotal$Condition== "HYes-P","YesPolite", "YesPolite")))))))

outputtotal$DetailedResponse<-as.factor(outputtotal$DetailedResponse)
outputtotal$Response<-as.factor(outputtotal$Response)

```

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r, echo=FALSE}
ANOVA_3Way <- aov(BlameResponse ~ Situation * DetailedResponse * Agent + Error(Subject), data =outputtotal) 
summary(ANOVA_3Way)

dust_ANOVA_3_Way <- dust(ANOVA_3Way) + 
  sprinkle(cols = c("sumsq", "meansq","statistic"), round = 2)+
  sprinkle(cols = "p.value", fn = quote(pvalString(value)))+
  sprinkle_colnames("Type","Factor","df","SS","Mean SS", "F","p")

summary(lm(BlameResponse ~ Situation * DetailedResponse *Agent, outputtotal))

ANOVA_3Way.means.sem <- ddply(outputtotal, c("Situation","DetailedResponse", "Agent"), summarise,mean=mean(BlameResponse, na.rm = TRUE), sem=sd(BlameResponse, na.rm = TRUE)/sqrt(468))

ANOVA_3Way.means.sem <- transform(ANOVA_3Way.means.sem, lower=mean-sem, upper=mean+sem)



dodge <- position_dodge(width=0.9)

plot_3Way <- ggplot(ANOVA_3Way.means.sem, aes(x = Agent, y = mean, fill = DetailedResponse))+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#FF0000", "burlywood4","#FFFFFF","gray"))+
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = dodge, color = "black")+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = upper, ymin = lower), width=0.2, position=position_dodge(0.9))+
  facet_grid(.~Situation)+
  labs(title = "Blame Response", x = "Agents", y = "Blame Rating")+
  theme_bw()
plot_3Way
ggsave("3-Way.png", width = 14, height = 10)

```
